name: class lowering and scope capture share the recorder
source: class Counter { constructor() { this.value = 1; } inc() { return ++this.value; } } var instance = new Counter(); var result = instance.inc();

name: class method reads updated captured bindings
source: var amount = 2; class Multiplier { multiply(value) { return value * amount; } } var instance = new Multiplier(); amount = 3; var result = instance.multiply(4);

name: function wrapper replacement controls captured calls
source: function add(value) { return value + offset; } var offset = 5; var answer = add(4);
setup: const calls = []; _rec.define = function(name, kind, value, recorder) { calls.push([name, kind, recorder === _rec]); return name === 'add' && kind === 'function' ? (...args) => value(...args) + 10 : value; };
evaluate: [_rec.answer, _rec.add(1), calls.some(([name, kind, same]) => name === 'add' && kind === 'function' && same)]

name: captured functions share mutation state
source: var total = 1; function update(delta) { total += delta; return total; } var first = update(2); var second = update(3);

name: top-level superclass binding survives the complete pipeline
source: class Base { m() { return 3; } } class Child extends Base { m() { return super.m() + 1; } } var result = new Child().m();

name: function wrapper metadata uses UTF16 offsets after Unicode
setup: const calls = []; _rec.define = (name, kind, value, recorder, meta) => { if (kind === 'function') calls.push([name, meta.start, meta.end, recorder === _rec]); return value; };
